hooks.command:
input=$(cat)

# Extract the first "command" value, then its first whitespace-delimited token.
cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n1 | awk '{print $1}')

allowed="ls cat grep find head tail wc echo pwd whoami date uname df du tree file which env printenv history stat"

# No command parsed -> allow (fail open; nothing to validate).
if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then
exit 0
fi

for a in $allowed; do
if [ "$cmd" = "$a" ]; then
exit 0
fi
done

cat <<EOF
{"decision": "deny", "reason": "🔒 STRICT MODE: The command '$cmd' is not in the whitelist. Only read-only operations are allowed: $allowed. If you need to modify files, please ask for permission to extend the whitelist."}
EOF
exit 2
